title: FBI-UAP-D019, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-4, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.description: A dark nighttime scene shows two human figures seen from behind, standing on flat ground in the lower-left foreground, outlined with a soft yellowish glow. The figure on the left appears taller and wears a jacket and pants; the figure on the right is slightly shorter. Behind them is a low, rolling ridge or hillside silhouetted against a deep blue star-filled sky. In the sky at right, near the horizon, there is a row of four small bright red dots followed by a single larger glowing yellowish-white orb. Numerous small white stars are scattered across the upper portion of the image.

observations.claim: Two human figures are shown from behind in the foreground
The figures have a faint yellow glowing outline
Four small red dots and one larger yellowish orb appear in the sky at right
The background sky is dark blue and filled with white star points
A low hill or ridge silhouette runs across the horizon
The left figure is taller than the right figure
